paragraphs: Hi there! I’m Shaibal, a recent Computer Engineering graduate from the University of Toronto with 16 months of software engineering internship experience. I’m interested in backend and full-stack work where reliability, performance, and product usability meet. My experience spans authentication services, developer tools, data pipelines, AI-assisted interfaces, and performance-sensitive systems built with Rust, TypeScript, Python, and C++. I also enjoy frontend work and have built React and Flutter interfaces for internal tools and AI-assisted applications.

I like tracing problems across system boundaries, from APIs and storage to the interfaces people use, and validating decisions through tests, profiling, and measurable results. I’m looking for a team where I can own meaningful work, learn from experienced engineers, and ship software used in real operations.
Outside of work, you can usually find me running, playing soccer, reading fantasy novels, or experimenting with game development.
